sections.name: Auto-config
sections.why: Records whether graphics auto-config has run.

sections.name: Graphics
sections.why: Main driving graphics: frame rate, detail, shadows, mirrors, lighting and effects.

sections.name: Driving screen
sections.why: One offset for rigs where bodywork hides the bottom of the screen.

sections.name: Interface
sections.why: UI opacity and width on wide screens, focus behaviour, particle threads.

sections.name: Display mode
sections.why: Window, full-screen and HDR output. Triple-screen users set the window span here by hand.

sections.name: Screen geometry
sections.why: Screen size, distance and angles for triple and curved setups; drives the FOV maths.

sections.name: Driver info
sections.why: Graphics driver details the sim writes. Not for editing.

sections.name: Laser scan
sections.why: Dot size and memory for laser scan point rendering. Almost nobody uses it.

sections.name: Replay graphics
sections.why: Separate graphics used for replays and spectating, when the camera is outside the car.

sections.name: Accessibility
sections.why: Visibility aids: bigger cursor, wider racing line, pit lines always shown.

sections.name: Sound
sections.why: Volumes and output devices. Most drivers adjust the mix at some point.

sections.name: Chat macros
sections.why: Canned chat lines and pit commands sent with a key press.
sections.note: Each macro is sent with its bound key. End it with $ to send it at once; # runs pit commands, e.g. #fuel 10l$.

sections.name: HUD profile
sections.why: Default HUD profile name. Normally picked in the sim.

sections.name: Bass shakers
sections.why: iRacing's own shaker output. Most SimHub users drive shakers from ShakeIt instead.

sections.name: Camera tool
sections.why: Controls for the camera editor, for broadcasters and video makers.

sections.name: Commercial venues
sections.why: Looping-qualify option for commercial and event rigs.

sections.name: Control profile
sections.why: Default control profile name. Normally picked in the sim.

sections.name: In-car HUD boxes
sections.why: Which HUD boxes show in the car. Mostly toggled with hotkeys while driving.

sections.name: Lighting and ARX
sections.why: RGB keyboard lighting, wheel LCDs and the Logitech ARX phone app. Niche hardware only.

sections.name: Force feedback
sections.why: Wheel feel, damping, pedal vibration and brand links. Main FFB sliders live in the sim.

sections.name: Max cars
sections.why: Holds only the Max cars limit, which affects FPS and timing apps.

sections.name: iRacing UI app
sections.why: Safe mode and loading screen for the iRacing UI app. Troubleshooting only.

sections.name: Units and clock
sections.why: Units and date/time display. Usually set once.

sections.name: Session screen
sections.why: Black box and weather radar state on the out-of-car session screen.

sections.name: Miscellaneous
sections.why: Telemetry output for SimHub and loggers, network routing, and in-car message filters.

sections.name: Notifications
sections.why: Internal marker for the What's New popup.

sections.name: Options search
sections.why: What the sim's Options search box matches. Almost nobody changes it.

sections.name: Broadcast ticker
sections.why: Ticker for broadcast or venue screens with the session UI hidden.

sections.name: Pit service
sections.why: Autofuel defaults and what the pit crew re-requests after each stop.

sections.name: Replay
sections.why: Replay saving, spooling to disk and playback behaviour.

sections.name: Setup auto-load
sections.why: Per-car copy of the garage auto-load box: 1 loads iRacing's track setup, 0 keeps yours.

sections.name: Spotter
sections.why: Spotter and crew chief calls. Many drivers want fewer or different callouts.

sections.name: Spectating
sections.why: Camera focus and spotter access when you join as a spectator.

sections.name: Splits and delta
sections.why: Delta bar scale, reference lap and ghost car options.

sections.name: Performance meters
sections.why: The FPS box and its network, CPU, GPU, audio and FFB meters.

sections.name: Tilt steering
sections.why: Steering by tilting a device with a tilt sensor, such as a tablet.

sections.name: Touch and mouse driving
sections.why: Driving with a mouse or touch screen instead of a wheel.

sections.name: Wheel haptics
sections.why: Rim vibration for Logitech TrueForce, Fanatec FullForce and Moza wheel LFE.

sections.name: Video and screenshots
sections.why: iRacing's built-in video and screenshot capture.

sections.name: Driver view
sections.why: Field of view, eye position, head movement and look controls.

sections.name: Developer only
sections.why: Debug, crash and capture switches for iRacing staff; only the performance meter pop-up matters.

sections.name: Network internals
sections.why: Low-level networking; only connect_sockets is a support-documented fix.

sections.name: Debug
sections.why: Developer debug switches.

sections.name: File cache
sections.why: Internal data file cache size.

sections.name: Pit lane
sections.why: Pit stall choice for local test sessions.

sections.name: Replay memory
sections.why: Replay memory size, plus telemetry recording flags nobody needs to touch.

sections.name: Server admin
sections.why: Race server options with no known client effect.

sections.name: Sound buffering
sections.why: Low-level buffer overrides, only for troubleshooting crackle or dropouts.

sections.name: Thread priority
sections.why: Windows thread priority behaviour; leave alone.

sections.name: Telemetry internals
sections.why: Undocumented; the SDK and .ibt switches are in app.ini [Misc].

sections.name: Updater
sections.why: Updater logging for support cases.

settings.label: Auto-config done
settings.help: Set to 0 to rerun graphics auto-config at the next launch.
settings.danger: Auto-config may overwrite your current graphics settings.

settings.label: File version
settings.help: Version of this file, written by the sim. Don't edit.

settings.label: Virtual mirror
settings.help: On-screen rear-view mirror.

settings.label: Trackside self-shadows
settings.help: Walls and trackside objects shadow themselves and each other. High FPS cost.

options.label: More self-shadowing objects when shadow mapping

settings.label: Night shadow filter
settings.help: Softens night shadow edges. Higher filters look better and cost more.

settings.label: Night shadow fade-in
settings.help: Fade-in time, in 1/100 s.

dependsOn.message: No effect: night shadows are off.

settings.label: Night shadow lights
settings.help: Most lights that cast shadows at night. Fewer is faster.

settings.label: Walls cast night shadows
settings.help: Track walls cast shadows from night lights. Costs FPS.

settings.label: Objects cast night shadows
settings.help: Trackside objects cast shadows from night lights. Costs FPS.

settings.label: Per-pixel night shadows
settings.help: Works out night shadows per pixel, not per anti-aliasing sample. Faster with MSAA.

settings.label: Night shadows
settings.help: Moving shadows from headlights and track lights.

settings.label: Auto exposure
settings.help: Adjusts brightness to the scene.

dependsOn.message: No effect: HDR rendering is off.

settings.label: Reflections in rain only
settings.help: Limits road reflections to wet sessions. Saves FPS in the dry.

settings.label: Road reflections
settings.help: Screen-space reflections on wet track and puddles. Costs GPU; high is full resolution.

settings.label: Two-pass trees
settings.help: Draws detailed tree models in two passes for a better look. Costs GPU.

options.label: Render trees with higher quality in two passes

settings.label: Track reflection updates
settings.help: Reflection maps of the track redrawn per frame. 100 is one per frame. Heavy; guides use 0.

settings.label: Car reflection updates
settings.help: Live reflection maps on cars redrawn per frame. 100 is one per frame. Heavy CPU and GPU cost.

settings.label: Replay render modes
settings.help: Adds replay-only filters such as greyscale, sepia and 8-bit. Uses extra GPU and memory.

settings.label: Distortion effects
settings.help: Post-process distortion effect, likely heat and exhaust shimmer. Off saves some GPU and memory.

settings.label: Sharpening limit
settings.help: Caps how strongly sharpening can change a pixel, 0 to 100. iRacing default: 10.

settings.label: Sharpening strength
settings.help: Strength when sharpening is on, 10 to 300. iRacing default: 125.

settings.label: Sharpening
settings.help: Post-process sharpening for crisper edges. Popular in VR. Small GPU cost.

settings.label: Ambient occlusion
settings.help: Soft contact shadows that add depth. Heavy GPU cost; most guides turn it off.
settings.caution: Large FPS cost, worse at high resolutions and on triples.

settings.label: TV camera motion blur
settings.help: Applies motion blur to broadcast cameras when strength is above off.

settings.label: In-car motion blur
settings.help: Applies motion blur to driving cameras when strength is above off.

settings.label: Motion blur strength
settings.help: Amount of motion blur. Off keeps detail sharp; costs more at high resolution and on triples.

settings.label: Heat haze
settings.help: Heat shimmer effect. Medium GPU cost and extra video memory.

settings.label: Depth of field
settings.help: Blurs out-of-focus areas, mainly for replay and TV cameras.

settings.label: Shadow maps
settings.help: Sun and cloud shadows on track and objects. Needed for overcast skies. Big FPS cost.

settings.label: Trim small shadow casters
settings.help: Skips dynamic shadows from small objects to save FPS.

options.label: Dynamic shadow maps trim some objects by size

settings.label: Car shadows
settings.help: Moving shadows from cars and other dynamic objects. Daytime only.

settings.label: Shadow detail
settings.help: How many objects cast shadows. Fewer saves FPS.

settings.label: Cockpit mirrors
settings.help: In-car mirrors to draw, 0 to 4. Each costs FPS. Use 0 if you rely on the virtual mirror.

settings.label: Mirror detail
settings.help: Full detail in mirrors. Large FPS cost; low is fine for most.
settings.caution: Large FPS cost, multiplied by each mirror.

settings.label: Full-res particles
settings.help: Smoke, dust and spray at full resolution. Off lets the sim lower it to save GPU.

settings.label: Particle detail
settings.help: Detail of smoke, dust and spray. Cost grows with car count; medium suits heavy rain.

settings.label: Event detail
settings.help: Extra event-specific trackside objects. Low saves CPU.

settings.label: Foliage
settings.help: Density of 3D grass and plants. Low or off saves FPS. Needs a restart.

settings.label: Trackside objects
settings.help: How many trackside objects are placed. Low saves CPU.

settings.label: Grandstand detail
settings.help: Grandstand model detail. A good first cut when FPS is low.

settings.label: Crowd detail
settings.help: Spectator detail. Higher adds the backs of people, rarely seen while driving.

settings.label: Pit detail
settings.help: Detail of pit crews and pit lane objects. Medium is a common choice.

settings.label: Car detail
settings.help: Model detail of other cars. Costs most at race starts.

settings.label: Sky update rate
settings.help: How often sky and clouds redraw. Low saves CPU but clouds can look jumpy.

settings.label: Mirror car drop limit
settings.help: How far car detail in mirrors may drop when FPS is low, in % (25 to 500).

settings.label: Mirror car boost limit
settings.help: How far car detail in mirrors may rise when FPS is spare, in %. Under 100 adds detail.

settings.label: Car detail drop limit
settings.help: How far car and pit crew detail may drop when FPS is low, in %. Higher gives more FPS.

settings.label: Car detail boost limit
settings.help: How far car and pit crew detail may rise when FPS is spare, in %. Under 100 adds detail.

settings.label: Mirror world drop limit
settings.help: How far scenery detail in mirrors may drop when FPS is low, in % (25 to 500).

settings.label: Mirror world boost limit
settings.help: How far scenery detail in mirrors may rise when FPS is spare, in %. Under 100 adds detail.

settings.label: World detail drop limit
settings.help: How far scenery detail may drop when FPS is low, in %. Higher gives more FPS.

settings.label: World detail boost limit
settings.help: How far scenery detail may rise when FPS is spare, in %. Under 100 adds detail.

settings.label: Dynamic detail FPS target
settings.help: Detail drops automatically when FPS falls below this. In VR, use the headset refresh rate.

settings.label: Pit objects in mirrors
settings.help: Most pit objects drawn in each mirror, 0 to 192. Lower saves FPS.

settings.label: Pit objects drawn
settings.help: Most pit crew and pit objects drawn per view, 0 to 192. Lower saves FPS.

settings.label: Cars drawn in mirrors
settings.help: Most cars drawn in each mirror, 4 to 64. Lower saves FPS.

settings.label: Cars drawn
settings.help: Most cars drawn on screen, 10 to 64. Lower saves CPU in big fields.

settings.label: Hide cockpit obstructions
settings.help: Hides the halo, A-pillars and rock screens for a clearer view.

settings.label: Driver hands
settings.help: Shows the driver's arms and hands. Small FPS cost.

settings.label: Steering wheel
settings.help: Shows the in-car wheel. Many hide it when their real wheel is in view.

options.label: Only with display
options.tip: Shown only when the car's wheel has a screen.

settings.label: VR render mode
settings.help: Stereo method for VR headsets. Likely has no effect in monitor mode.

options.label: Single pass stereo
options.tip: Both eyes in one pass. NVIDIA only.

options.label: Foveated quad view
options.tip: Sharp centre, lower-res edges. RTX 2000+ and OpenXR.

settings.label: Tyre marks
settings.help: Draws skid marks on the track surface.

settings.label: HDR rendering
settings.help: Wider lighting range inside the sim. Not Windows HDR.

settings.label: Resolution scaling
settings.help: Renders lower and upscales with AMD FSR. Needs anti-aliasing on; restart to apply.

settings.label: NVIDIA Reflex
settings.help: Reduces render latency. NVIDIA GPUs only.

options.label: On + boost
options.tip: Also holds GPU clocks high. More power and heat.

settings.label: Contrast
settings.help: Scene contrast, -6 to +6. Guides report it needs HDR rendering on.

settings.label: Brightness
settings.help: Scene brightness, -6 to +6. Guides report it needs HDR rendering on.

settings.label: FSR sharpness
settings.help: Sharpening applied after FSR upscaling. Used only when resolution scaling is on.

settings.label: Gamma
settings.help: Gamma, -6 to +6. Guides report it needs HDR rendering on.

settings.label: 32-bit depth buffer
settings.help: Reduces z-fighting flicker, mainly on NVIDIA. Doubles depth buffer memory.

settings.label: Low-quality trees
settings.help: Simpler tree rendering for more FPS.

settings.label: Trees sway in wind
settings.help: Animates trees in the wind. Off may save a little FPS.

settings.label: Track surface displacement
settings.help: Uses displacement shaders for 3D track surface detail. Off may gain FPS.

settings.label: Night lights per pass
settings.help: Shadowing lights drawn per pass, 0 to 6. Lower may be faster on low-end GPUs.

settings.label: Static shadow maps
settings.help: High-quality static shadow maps to use, 3 to 8. More uses more video memory.

settings.label: Static shadow resolution
settings.help: Resolution of static shadow maps. Higher is sharper and uses more video memory.
settings.caution: 8192 uses hundreds of MB of video memory.

settings.label: Car shadow resolution
settings.help: Resolution of the 3 dynamic shadow maps. Higher is sharper; memory cost is 3x.
settings.caution: 8192 uses hundreds of MB of video memory.

settings.label: Shader quality
settings.help: Lighting and surface shading quality. Anti-aliasing options need medium or higher.

settings.label: Headlight quality
settings.help: Headlight rendering detail. High costs FPS at night.

settings.label: Multithreaded scene sort
settings.help: Sorts the scene on several CPU threads. Leave on.

settings.label: White headlights
settings.help: Renders all headlights white. Reduces blotches and banding.

settings.label: Headlights in mirrors
settings.help: Headlights light the track surface in mirrors. Costs FPS at night.

options.label: Headlights illuminate track surface in mirrors

settings.label: Load textures while driving
settings.help: Loads new textures, such as car paints, while on track. 0 waits until you leave the car.

settings.label: Number of GPUs
settings.help: GPUs in SLI or Crossfire, 1 to 4. Leave at 1 with a single card.
settings.caution: Higher than your GPU count wastes video memory.

settings.label: Compress suit textures
settings.help: Block-compresses driver suit textures to save video memory. Leave on.

settings.label: Compress helmet textures
settings.help: Block-compresses helmet textures to save video memory. Leave on.

settings.label: Compress car textures
settings.help: Leave on. Off uses far more video memory.
settings.danger: Turning this off makes car textures use several times more video memory.

settings.label: Compress model data
settings.help: Compresses 3D model vertex data to save system and video memory. Leave on.

settings.label: Reduce cockpit flicker
settings.help: Cuts flicker between cockpit parts, seen at very large tracks. Leave on.

settings.label: High-res car paints
settings.help: Car paints at 2048 instead of 1024 pixels. Sharper liveries, about 150 MB more video memory.

settings.label: Nearest car paint swap
settings.help: Full-res paints on the nearest cars; others shrink to fit memory. For low-VRAM cards.

options.label: Shrink to fit
options.tip: All paints reduced to fit memory.

settings.label: Near clip distance
settings.help: Higher fixes flicker but can clip the track ahead.
settings.danger: Values above 10 can hide the track surface right in front of the car.

settings.label: Visibility check delay
settings.help: Frames between object visibility checks. Lower culls sooner but costs CPU.

settings.label: MSAA filter
settings.help: How samples are blended.

dependsOn.message: No effect: anti-aliasing is not MSAA.

settings.label: MSAA samples
settings.help: More samples: smoother edges, lower FPS.

dependsOn.message: No effect: anti-aliasing is not MSAA.

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.help: Smooths jagged edges.

settings.label: Texture sharpness bias
settings.help: Shifts texture detail level, in % (100 is one level). Negative is sharper but shimmers.

settings.label: No FPS-based pop-out
settings.help: On stops dynamic detail scaling from making objects vanish early. Purpose partly unclear.

settings.label: Occlusion culling
settings.help: Skips drawing objects hidden behind others. Leave on; off costs FPS.

settings.label: Limit frame rate
settings.help: Caps FPS at the value below.

settings.label: Frame rate cap
settings.help: Used only when the limit is on.

dependsOn.message: No effect: frame rate limit is off.

settings.label: Pre-rendered frames
settings.help: Lower means less input lag. iRacing default: 1.

options.tip: Default. Lowest lag that stays smooth.
Smoother in heavy scenes, more lag.

settings.label: Vertical sync
settings.help: Locks FPS to the refresh rate. Removes tearing, adds lag.

settings.label: System memory limit
settings.help: Most system RAM the sim uses, in MB (1024 to 32768).

settings.label: Video memory limit
settings.help: Most GPU memory the sim uses, in MB. Keep a little under your card's VRAM.
settings.caution: Set above real VRAM can cause stutter.

settings.label: Interface size
settings.help: Size of menus and overlays, in %. Also in Settings, Interface tab.

settings.label: Raise bottom of UI
settings.help: Moves the bottom of the driving UI up, in %. For rigs where bodywork hides the screen edge.

settings.label: Session UI opacity
settings.help: Opacity of the session screen UI. 0 is transparent, 1 is solid.

settings.label: Session UI max width
settings.help: Widest aspect ratio the session UI uses on wide or triple screens. Default 1.8.

settings.label: Session UI full width
settings.help: Lets the session UI span the full display on triples or ultrawides.

settings.label: Full FPS when another app is focused
settings.help: Keeps the sim at full FPS while SimHub or another app has focus.

settings.label: Particle thread priority
settings.help: CPU priority of particle worker threads. Leave at normal.

settings.label: Dirt settings warning
settings.help: Session screen warns when graphics settings are too low for dirt tracks.

settings.label: Particle threads
settings.help: Worker threads for smoke and dust, 0 to 6. Lower frees CPU cores.

settings.label: Keep sim menus hidden on click
settings.help: Menus open only with the space bar.

settings.label: Hide car numbers
settings.help: Hides numbers and decals in test sessions so you can preview your own paint.

settings.label: Show hidden when editing
settings.help: Shows every movable overlay while you arrange the UI, including hidden ones.

settings.label: Crowds in practice
settings.help: Shows grandstand crowds in practice and qualifying too.

settings.label: Driving UI opacity
settings.help: 0 is transparent, 1 is solid.

settings.label: Driving UI max width
settings.help: Widest aspect ratio the driving UI uses on wide or triple screens. Default 1.8.

settings.label: Driving UI full width
settings.help: Lets driving overlays spread across the full width of triples or ultrawides.

settings.label: Top edge
settings.help: Desktop y position.

settings.label: Left edge
settings.help: Desktop x position.

settings.label: Width
settings.help: Should span all three screens.

settings.label: Start maximised
settings.help: Fills one screen and ignores the width and height. Keep off for a window across triples.

settings.label: Height
settings.help: Usually your screen height.

settings.label: Window alignment
settings.help: Where the window snaps. None uses the edge positions above; keep None for triples.

options.label: None
options.tip: Uses the left and top edge values.

options.label: Centre
options.tip: Centres the window on the screen.

options.label: Top left
options.tip: Pins the window to the top-left corner.

settings.label: Pixel shape (window)
settings.help: Corrects screens with non-square pixels in windowed mode. Leave at 1.0 on normal monitors.

settings.label: Pixel shape (full screen)
settings.help: Corrects screens with non-square pixels in full screen. Leave at 1.0 on normal monitors.

settings.label: Refresh rate
settings.help: Refresh rate in Hz used in full screen. Should match your monitor, e.g. 144.

settings.label: Resolution scaling
settings.help: How a full-screen resolution below native is fitted to the screen.

options.label: Centred
options.tip: Native pixels, black borders round the image.

options.label: Stretched
options.tip: Stretches the image to fill the screen.

settings.label: HDR output
settings.help: Sends HDR to an HDR display. Needs full screen and HDR switched on in Windows.
settings.caution: Colours can look blown out if the sim drops out of full screen.

settings.label: Full-screen width
settings.help: Full-screen resolution width in pixels. For Surround triples, all three screens.

settings.label: Full-screen height
settings.help: Full-screen resolution height in pixels.

settings.label: Colour depth
settings.help: Bits per pixel. 32 is standard; 64 with HDR output selects HDR16F.

settings.label: Full screen
settings.help: Exclusive full screen. Off runs in a window; with the border off that is borderless.

settings.label: Screen rotation
settings.help: Output orientation. Auto follows Windows; change only for a rotated display.

settings.label: Graphics adapter
settings.help: Which GPU the sim renders on. 0 is the first; change only with more than one GPU.

settings.label: Window border
settings.help: Off for a borderless window across screens.

settings.label: Keep HUD off bezels
settings.help: Margin from the bezels, % of screen width.

settings.label: Ease angles when zoomed
settings.help: Relaxes side-screen angles when a camera zooms in a lot. Cuts stretching in TV views.

settings.label: Screen shape
settings.help: Curved screens need a radius.

settings.label: Number of screens
settings.help: 1 or 3.

settings.label: NVIDIA multi-projection
settings.help: Renders all three screens in one pass. NVIDIA only.

settings.label: Separate view per screen
settings.help: Less stretching toward the edges.

settings.label: Curve radius
settings.help: The R rating. 1800R is 1800 mm.

settings.label: Eyes to centre screen
settings.help: Measured straight ahead.

settings.label: Monitor width
settings.help: Full width of one monitor, with bezels.

settings.label: Screen width
settings.help: Visible width of one screen, without bezels.

settings.label: Side screen angle
settings.help: How far each side screen turns in.

settings.label: Graphics driver file
settings.help: Driver DLL the sim records for diagnostics. Don't edit.
settings.danger: iRacing marks this as not to be edited.

settings.label: Graphics driver version
settings.help: Driver version the sim records for diagnostics. Don't edit.
settings.danger: iRacing marks this as not to be edited.

settings.label: Graphics driver vendor
settings.help: Driver vendor the sim records for diagnostics. Don't edit.
settings.danger: iRacing marks this as not to be edited.

settings.label: Scan dot size
settings.help: Physical width of laser scan dots, in mm (1 to 120). Distant dots draw smaller.

settings.label: Scan dot min size
settings.help: Smallest laser scan dot on screen, in pixels.

settings.label: Scan dot max size
settings.help: Largest laser scan dot on screen, in pixels.

settings.label: Scan video memory
settings.help: Video memory for laser scan data, in MB (128 to 768). Lower if scans render slowly.

settings.label: Object self-shadows
settings.help: More track objects cast shadows onto themselves. In replays.

settings.label: Night shadow filter
settings.help: Smooths night shadow edges. Higher looks better, costs more GPU. In replays.

settings.label: Night shadow fade-in
settings.help: Fade-in time, in 1/100 s. Lower pops more. In replays.

settings.label: Night shadow lights
settings.help: Max lights casting shadows at night, 0 to 128. More costs FPS. In replays.

settings.label: Wall night shadows
settings.help: Track walls cast shadows at night. In replays.

settings.label: Object night shadows
settings.help: Pit signs and other track objects cast night shadows, not only cars. In replays.

settings.label: Night shadow sampling
settings.help: Per-pixel is faster with many lights, slightly lower quality. In replays.

settings.label: Night shadows
settings.help: Moving shadows from headlights and track lights. In replays.

settings.label: Auto exposure
settings.help: Adjusts brightness to the scene. Needs HDR on. In replays.

settings.label: Reflections in wet only
settings.help: Limits screen reflections to wet sessions. Needs reflections on. In replays.

options.label: Wet only
options.tip: Only when the session is declared wet.

settings.label: Screen reflections
settings.help: Screen space reflections, most visible on a wet track. High costs FPS. In replays.

settings.label: Two-pass trees
settings.help: Draws trees in two passes for better quality. Costs FPS. In replays.

settings.label: Fixed cubemaps
settings.help: Purpose not documented. Likely static reflection map updates; 100 = 1 per frame.

settings.label: Dynamic cubemaps
settings.help: Car reflection updates per frame; 100 = 1 per frame. In replays.
settings.caution: Large FPS cost. iRacing ships it at 0.

settings.label: Replay render modes
settings.help: Adds visual filters such as greyscale or sepia to the replay timeline.

settings.label: Distortion effects
settings.help: Screen distortion effects. Uses extra video memory. In replays.

settings.label: Sharpening clamp
settings.help: Limits how hard sharpening can push. Higher can look jagged. In replays.

settings.label: Sharpening strength
settings.help: Strength from 10 to 300. Needs sharpening on. In replays.

settings.label: Sharpening
settings.help: Sharpens edges to reduce blur. In replays.

settings.label: Ambient occlusion
settings.help: Soft shadows in corners and creases. Costs FPS. In replays.

settings.label: Blur on TV cameras
settings.help: Motion blur on broadcast cameras. Needs blur strength above off.

settings.label: Blur on driving cameras
settings.help: Motion blur on cockpit and chase cameras. Needs blur strength above off.

settings.label: Motion blur strength
settings.help: Off disables motion blur on all cameras. In replays.

settings.label: Heat haze
settings.help: Heat shimmer in the air, tied to air and track temperature. In replays.

settings.label: Depth of field
settings.help: Blurs out-of-focus areas, mostly on TV cameras. In replays.

settings.label: Cloud shadows
settings.help: Shadow maps on the track and objects. Keep on for clouds and overcast to look right.

settings.label: Shadow trim
settings.help: Skips dynamic shadows on some small objects to save FPS. In replays.

settings.label: Dynamic shadows
settings.help: Moving shadows from cars and objects in daylight. Heavy on FPS. In replays.

settings.label: Shadow detail
settings.help: Maximum draws more shadows. In replays.

settings.label: Virtual mirror
settings.help: Draws the on-screen virtual mirror. In replays.

settings.label: Cockpit mirrors
settings.help: How many car mirrors render, 0 to 4. In replays.

settings.label: Mirror detail
settings.help: Detail level in mirrors. In replays.

settings.label: Full-res particles
settings.help: Smoke, dust and sparks at full resolution. In replays.

settings.label: Particle detail
settings.help: Amount of smoke, dust and sparks. In replays.

settings.label: Event detail
settings.help: Extra trackside objects on race days. Mostly CPU. In replays.

settings.label: Foliage density
settings.help: Grass and plants around the track. In replays.

settings.label: Object detail
settings.help: How many trackside objects appear. In replays.

settings.label: Grandstand detail
settings.help: Grandstand detail level. In replays.

settings.label: Crowd detail
settings.help: High adds crowd backs, which TV cameras can show. In replays.

options.label: High
options.tip: Adds crowd backs. Best for TV cameras.

settings.label: Pit detail
settings.help: Pit crews and pit lane objects. In replays.

settings.label: Car detail
settings.help: Car model detail. In replays.

settings.label: Sky refresh rate
settings.help: Lower saves FPS but the sky can look jumpy. In replays.

settings.label: Mirror car drop limit
settings.help: How far car detail in mirrors may drop to hold the FPS target, up to 500%.

settings.label: Mirror car boost limit
settings.help: How far car detail in mirrors may rise when FPS is spare, down to 25%.

settings.label: Car drop limit
settings.help: How far car detail may drop to hold the FPS target, up to 500%. In replays.

settings.label: Car boost limit
settings.help: How far car detail may rise when FPS is spare, down to 25%. In replays.

settings.label: Mirror scenery drop limit
settings.help: How far scenery in mirrors may drop in detail to hold the FPS target, up to 500%.

settings.label: Mirror scenery boost limit
settings.help: How far scenery in mirrors may rise in detail when FPS is spare, down to 25%.

settings.label: Scenery drop limit
settings.help: How far scenery detail may drop to hold the FPS target, up to 500%. In replays.

settings.label: Scenery boost limit
settings.help: How far scenery detail may rise when FPS is spare, down to 25%. In replays.

settings.label: FPS target
settings.help: Detail drops when FPS falls below this. In replays.

settings.label: Pit objects in mirrors
settings.help: Max pit objects drawn per mirror, 0 to 192.

settings.label: Pit objects drawn
settings.help: Max pit crews and objects drawn per camera, 0 to 192. In replays.

settings.label: Cars in mirrors
settings.help: Max cars drawn per mirror, 4 to 64.

settings.label: Cars drawn
settings.help: Max cars drawn per camera, 10 to 64. Lower saves FPS in big fields. In replays.

settings.label: Hide cockpit obstructions
settings.help: Hides the halo, A-pillars or rock screen in cockpit views. In replays.

settings.label: Driver hands
settings.help: Shows the driver's arms and hands in cockpit views. In replays.

settings.label: Steering wheel
settings.help: Shows the 3D steering wheel in cockpit views. In replays.

options.label: Fixed
options.tip: Not documented. Likely drawn but not turning.

options.label: Only with a display
options.tip: Shown only if the wheel has a screen.

settings.label: High-contrast cursor
settings.help: Larger mouse cursor in a more contrasting colour.

settings.label: Always show pit lines
settings.help: Shows pit entry and exit lines at all times, not only when a pit exit rule applies.

settings.label: Racing line width
settings.help: Width of the racing line, in metres (0.1 to 2). Wider is easier to see.

settings.label: Mute active reset sounds
settings.help: Silences the audio cues played when you trigger an active reset.

settings.label: Hardware sound streams
settings.help: DirectSound only. Uses the sound card's hardware streams when available.

settings.label: Mute trackside music
settings.help: Mutes music from trackside PA speakers and similar sources.

settings.label: Bass shaker sound API
settings.help: Sound API for the bass shaker (LFE) device. None means no device.

settings.label: Bass shaker device mode
settings.help: Plays bass shaker effects on the device picked in the sim, or a Windows default device.

options.label: Selected device
options.tip: The device chosen in the sim's options.

options.label: Windows default
options.tip: Follows the Windows default playback device.

options.label: Windows comms default
options.tip: Follows the Windows default communications device.

settings.label: Bass shaker device ID
settings.help: Internal ID of the bass shaker device. Set by picking the device in the sim.
settings.readOnlyNote: Set by picking the device in iRacing's audio options.

settings.label: Bass shaker device name
settings.help: Display name of the bass shaker device. Set by picking the device in the sim.
settings.readOnlyNote: Set by picking the device in iRacing's audio options.

settings.label: Microphone sound API
settings.help: Sound API for the voice chat microphone. None means no mic.

settings.label: Microphone device ID
settings.help: Internal ID of the microphone device. Set by picking the device in the sim.
settings.readOnlyNote: Set by picking the device in iRacing's audio options.

settings.label: Microphone device name
settings.help: Display name of the microphone device. Set by picking the device in the sim.
settings.readOnlyNote: Set by picking the device in iRacing's audio options.

settings.label: Spotter sound API
settings.help: Sound API for spotter and crew chief audio. None means no device.

settings.label: Spotter device mode
settings.help: Plays the spotter on the device picked in the sim, or a Windows default device.

options.label: Selected device
options.tip: The device chosen in the sim's options.

options.label: Windows default
options.tip: Follows the Windows default playback device.

options.label: Windows comms default
options.tip: Follows the Windows default communications device.

settings.label: Spotter device ID
settings.help: Internal ID of the spotter device. Set by picking the device in the sim.
settings.readOnlyNote: Set by picking the device in iRacing's audio options.

settings.label: Spotter device name
settings.help: Display name of the spotter device. Set by picking the device in the sim.
settings.readOnlyNote: Set by picking the device in iRacing's audio options.

settings.label: Speaker sound API
settings.help: XAudio2 is the default and needed for environmental sounds. DirectSound is a fallback.

options.label: XAudio2
options.tip: Default. Better surround and more effects.

settings.label: Speaker device mode
settings.help: Plays game sound on the device picked in the sim, or a Windows default device.

options.label: Selected device
options.tip: The device chosen in the sim's options.

options.label: Windows default
options.tip: Follows the Windows default playback device.

options.label: Windows comms default
options.tip: Follows the Windows default communications device.

settings.label: Speaker device ID
settings.help: Internal ID of the speaker device. Set by picking the device in the sim.
settings.readOnlyNote: Set by picking the device in iRacing's audio options.

settings.label: Speaker device name
settings.help: Display name of the speaker device. Set by picking the device in the sim.
settings.readOnlyNote: Set by picking the device in iRacing's audio options.

settings.label: Voice chat sound API
settings.help: Sound API for incoming voice chat. None means no device.

settings.label: Voice chat device mode
settings.help: Plays voice chat on the device picked in the sim, or a Windows default device.

options.label: Selected device
options.tip: The device chosen in the sim's options.

options.label: Windows default
options.tip: Follows the Windows default playback device.

options.label: Windows comms default
options.tip: Follows the Windows default communications device.

settings.label: Voice chat device ID
settings.help: Internal ID of the voice chat device. Set by picking the device in the sim.
settings.readOnlyNote: Set by picking the device in iRacing's audio options.

settings.label: Voice chat device name
settings.help: Display name of the voice chat device. Set by picking the device in the sim.
settings.readOnlyNote: Set by picking the device in iRacing's audio options.

settings.label: Speaker layout
settings.help: Mono, stereo or surround mix. Guides suggest surround even on stereo headphones.

settings.label: Blocked downshift sound
settings.help: Plays a warning sound when the car refuses a downshift to protect the engine.

settings.label: Surround voice and spotter
settings.help: DirectSound only. Places voice chat and spotter in the surround mix.

settings.label: Ambient volume
settings.help: Crowds, PA and other trackside sounds, in dB.

settings.label: Crash volume
settings.help: Contact, scrape and crash sounds, in dB.

settings.label: Engine volume
settings.help: Engine sounds in dB. Lower it if engines drown out tyres or the spotter.

settings.label: Own car volume
settings.help: Your car's sounds in cockpit view, relative to other cars. -20 to 0 dB.

settings.label: Bass shaker strength
settings.help: Overall bass shaker effect level in dB. Separate from master volume.

settings.label: Rain volume
settings.help: Rain sounds in dB.

settings.label: Replay volume
settings.help: Replay volume relative to driving, in dB.

settings.label: Spotter volume
settings.help: Spotter and crew chief voice in dB.

settings.label: Tyre volume
settings.help: Tyre sounds in dB, including squeal near the grip limit.

settings.label: Menu sounds volume
settings.help: Menu and interface sounds in dB.

settings.label: Voice chat volume
settings.help: Incoming voice chat in dB.

settings.label: Wind volume
settings.help: Wind noise in dB.

settings.label: Master volume
settings.help: Overall sim volume in dB, from -40 to 0.

settings.label: Keep mic open
settings.help: Set to 0 if graphics stutter with a mic set up. Can stutter more while you talk.

settings.label: Mute when unfocused
settings.help: Mutes the sim when another app has focus. Set 0 to keep sound while using SimHub.

settings.label: Max sounds at once
settings.help: Caps how many sounds play at the same time. -1 is unlimited.
settings.danger: Low values can cut sounds you rely on, such as the spotter.

settings.label: Resample spotter audio
settings.help: Compatibility fix for sound cards with limited playback rates. Leave off otherwise.

settings.label: Resample voice chat
settings.help: Compatibility fix for sound cards with limited playback rates. Leave off otherwise.

settings.label: Radio scripts
settings.help: Runs radio channel scripts from Documents\iRacing\scripts\radio on launch, driving and spotting.

settings.label: Environmental reverb
settings.help: Reverb from the surroundings. Blank leaves the sim default.

settings.label: VR audio rotation
settings.help: Turns the sound stage with your head in VR so cars stay placed around you.

settings.label: Volume sliders in dB
settings.help: Shows the sim's volume sliders in dB, or 0 to 100. Display only.

settings.label: Voice chat
settings.help: Turns voice chat on or off.

settings.label: Voice chat while driving
settings.help: Set 0 to turn voice chat off while you drive.

settings.label: Mute voice chat
settings.help: Mutes voice chat regardless of the voice chat volume.

settings.label: Talker notice style
settings.help: Purpose not documented. Likely how the sim shows who is talking on the radio.

settings.label: Voice chat in replays
settings.help: Which radio channels are saved into replays. Also set in the sim's replay options.

settings.label: Game audio to LFE
settings.help: Set 0 to keep game audio off the sound card's LFE channel when shakers share it.

settings.label: Default HUD profile
settings.help: HUD profile loaded at sim start for cars without their own. Profiles are in profiles\hud.

settings.label: Game audio effects
settings.help: Feeds low-passed game audio to the shakers. Turn off for physics effects only.

settings.label: ButtKicker amp cut
settings.help: Cuts output by 10 dB so a ButtKicker BKA amp's input limiter doesn't distort.

settings.label: Physics effects
settings.help: Sends physics effects such as kerbs, slip and shifts to the shakers.

settings.label: Game audio cutoff
settings.help: Game audio above this frequency, in Hz, is filtered out before it reaches the shakers.

settings.label: Physics high-pass
settings.help: Filters physics effects below this frequency, in Hz. Try 25 to 50 if shakers boom. -1 is off.

settings.label: Bass shaker output
settings.help: Turns iRacing's bass shaker output on or off. Also set in the sim's options.

settings.label: Game audio level
settings.help: Level of the game audio shaker signal, in dB. Negative is weaker.

settings.label: Body movement
settings.help: Chassis load changes, impacts and heavy kerb hits on the shakers, in dB.

settings.label: Engine revs
settings.help: Engine vibration that follows revs on the shakers, in dB.

settings.label: Gear change
settings.help: Thump on each shift on the shakers, in dB.

settings.label: Rev limiter
settings.help: Pulse at the rev limiter on the shakers, in dB.

settings.label: Road texture
settings.help: Constant surface grain on the shakers, in dB. Usually kept low.

settings.label: Kerbs
settings.help: Rumble strip and kerb vibration on the shakers, in dB.

settings.label: Wheel slip
settings.help: Tyre slip vibration on the shakers, in dB. Also carries ABS.

settings.label: Auto shot selection
settings.help: Switches cameras when the car leaves view. Off gives you manual control.

settings.label: Temporary edits
settings.help: Camera edits are forgotten when the camera loses focus. For live events.

settings.label: Key acceleration
settings.help: Camera moves faster the longer you hold a key.

settings.label: Fast mode multiplier
settings.help: Speed multiplier used by fast move mode. 10 means 10x.

settings.label: Fast mode for all
settings.help: Applies fast mode to every adjustment, not only movement.

settings.label: Fast move mode
settings.help: Multiplies keyboard camera moves by 10.

settings.label: Key step size
settings.help: Base speed of keyboard camera moves. Higher is faster.

settings.label: Focus curve
settings.help: Joystick focus response. 1 is linear, 6 is very non-linear.

settings.label: Focus speed
settings.help: Joystick focus adjustment speed.

settings.label: Zoom curve
settings.help: Joystick zoom response. 1 is linear, 6 is very non-linear.

settings.label: Zoom speed
settings.help: Joystick zoom adjustment speed.

settings.label: Constant pan speed
settings.help: 0 slows panning as you zoom in. 1 keeps pan speed constant.

settings.label: Other controls curve
settings.help: Joystick response for other camera controls. 1 is linear, 6 is very non-linear.

settings.label: Other controls speed
settings.help: Joystick speed for other camera controls.

settings.label: Stay on platform
settings.help: Keeps the camera on its blimp or chopper in mouse aim mode.

settings.label: Keep mouse aim position
settings.help: Saves the camera's new position and angle when you leave mouse aim mode.

settings.label: Aim curve
settings.help: Joystick yaw, pitch and roll response. 1 is linear, 6 is very non-linear.

settings.label: Aim speed
settings.help: Joystick yaw, pitch and roll speed.

settings.label: Move curve
settings.help: Joystick x, y, z movement response. 1 is linear, 6 is very non-linear.

settings.label: Move speed
settings.help: Joystick x, y, z movement speed.

settings.label: Skip empty results
settings.help: In looping qualifying, skips the results screen when no valid lap was set. For venue rigs.

settings.label: Default control profile
settings.help: Control profile the sim loads by default. Profiles are the folders in profiles\controls.

settings.label: Open black box
settings.help: Which F-key black box is open in the car. -1 is none. Index order not documented.

settings.label: Collapse black box
settings.help: Shows in-car black boxes in their compact state. Off shows the extra columns.

settings.label: Pit stop black box
settings.help: Purpose not documented. Likely the black box shown while you sit in your pit stall.

settings.label: Dash box
settings.help: Shows the Dash box with colour-coded RPM and temperatures. D key in the car.

settings.label: Reset exits car
settings.help: Pressing reset in your pit stall leaves the car. Off stops accidental exits.

settings.label: Radio box
settings.help: Shows the radio channel box while driving. O key in the car.

settings.label: Speed and pedals box
settings.help: Shows the speed, gear, pedal and wheel box. P key in the car.

settings.label: Video sync timer
settings.help: Shows an on-screen clock for syncing live video with a replay.

settings.label: ARX layout
settings.help: Layout shown in the Logitech ARX phone app. Custom packs go in Documents\iRacing\arx.

settings.label: Colour hotkeys by type
settings.help: Colours keyboard hotkey lights by function. Off uses one colour for all.

settings.label: Wheel LCD screen
settings.help: Drives the built-in LCD on wheels that have one.

settings.label: Flag lighting
settings.help: Flashes flag colours on RGB keyboard and device backlights.

settings.label: Hotkey lighting
settings.help: Lights up the sim's hotkeys on an RGB keyboard.

settings.label: Shift light lighting
settings.help: Shows RPM shift lights on RGB keyboard backlights.

settings.label: Logitech ARX
settings.help: Sends a digital dash to your phone through the Logitech ARX app.

settings.label: RGB lighting
settings.help: Master switch for lighting effects on RGB keyboards and other lit devices.

settings.label: Phone steering
settings.help: A phone running ARX works as a steering wheel.

settings.label: Restart forces on update
settings.help: Restarts each force effect as it updates. Keep on if the wheel goes limp mid-session.

settings.label: Raw calibration data
settings.help: Reads raw axis positions instead of Windows calibration when detecting new devices.

settings.label: Centring spring
settings.help: Adds a fixed centring spring, 0 to 100%. -1 is off. iRacing advises against it.

settings.label: Launch control mode
settings.help: Sets whether the dual-clutch launch button works on release or while held.

options.label: Press and release
options.tip: Launch control acts when you release the button.

options.label: Press and hold
options.tip: Launch control acts while you hold the button.

settings.label: Damper effect type
settings.help: Wheel effect used for damping: damper, inertia or friction. Leave at damper unless testing.

options.label: Inertia
options.tip: Adds a feeling of rim mass.

settings.label: Damper saturation
settings.help: Caps the damper effect's force, 0 to 10000. Higher allows a stronger damper.

settings.label: Damping slider uses friction
settings.help: On: the in-sim damping slider sets iRacing's friction effect. Off: the wheel's own damping.

settings.label: Shifter debounce
settings.help: Ignores repeat shifts within this many ms. Raise it if paddles double-shift.

settings.label: Disable auto-centre
settings.help: Turns off the wheel driver's auto-centre spring so it doesn't fight iRacing's FFB. Keep on.

settings.label: Show force in Nm
settings.help: Shows the wheel force setting in peak Nm when linear mode is on.

settings.label: 360 Hz force feedback
settings.help: Sends 360 Hz FFB to wheels that support it. Turn off if the wheel buzzes or rattles.

settings.label: USB hot plugging
settings.help: Detects devices plugged in while the sim runs. Turn off if USB devices keep dropping out.

settings.label: Runaway protection
settings.help: Cuts FFB when the wheel spins too fast. Only turn off for force feedback joysticks.
settings.danger: Off removes the safety cut if a wheel spins out of control.

settings.label: Wheel displays
settings.help: Drives wheel displays and shift lights. Turn off if SimHub or another app drives them.

settings.label: Blink at rev limit
settings.help: Flashes wheel display lights at the rev limiter.

settings.label: Min force style
settings.help: How the min force slider applies. Smoothed compresses small forces; old mode steps them.

options.label: Smoothed
options.tip: Blends min force into small forces. Default.

options.label: Sharp (old)
options.tip: Legacy method. Small forces jump to the min level.

settings.label: Suppress noisy axes
settings.help: Ignores axes that jitter, even if calibrated by hand. Try if a stray axis fires inputs.

settings.label: Reset FFB per effect
settings.help: Resets the whole FFB system whenever an effect is created or removed. Troubleshooting only.

settings.label: Init only new devices
settings.help: On a device change, only new devices initialise. Set 0 to reinitialise all of them.

settings.label: Vibrate all gamepads
settings.help: When pedals vibrate, vibrate every XInput device, not only the one used to steer.

settings.label: Pedal vibration
settings.help: Vibrates supported pedals from physics, such as on brake lockup.

settings.label: Vibrate throttle too
settings.help: Vibrates the throttle along with the brake. Set 0 to silence Fanatec throttle motors.

settings.label: Vibrate wheel too
settings.help: Vibrates the wheel whenever the pedals vibrate.

settings.label: Lockup for full vibration
settings.help: Lockup level at which pedals vibrate at 100%. Lower it if vibration feels weak.

settings.label: Lockup before vibration
settings.help: Lockup level before pedals start to vibrate. Raise it if they vibrate too often.

settings.label: Asetek API
settings.help: Direct link to Asetek wheels for 360 Hz FFB. Set 0 to fall back to plain 60 Hz FFB.

settings.label: Conspit pedal API
settings.help: Links to Conspit pedals, likely for pedal haptics. Set 0 to troubleshoot.

settings.label: Conspit wheel API
settings.help: Direct link to Conspit wheel bases, used for 360 Hz FFB. Set 0 to troubleshoot.

settings.label: Fanatec API
settings.help: Direct link to Fanatec bases for FullForce haptics. Set 0 to troubleshoot.

settings.label: Moza API
settings.help: Direct link to Moza bases for 360 Hz FFB and wheel LFE haptics. Set 0 to troubleshoot.

settings.label: Simagic API
settings.help: Direct link to Simagic hardware, including P-HPR pedal haptics and 360 Hz FFB.

settings.label: Simucube API
settings.help: Direct link to Simucube bases for 360 Hz FFB. Needs a current True Drive.

settings.label: VRS API
settings.help: Direct link to VRS bases for 360 Hz FFB. Set 0 to fall back to plain 60 Hz FFB.

settings.label: Reset on FFB loss
settings.help: Resets the wheel if SteamVR or another app interrupts FFB. Can drop steering for a moment.

settings.label: Split gamepad triggers
settings.help: Gives Xbox 360 pad triggers separate axes, so gas and brake can be pressed together.

settings.label: Old Simucube detection
settings.help: Uses the previous Simucube detection method. Try only if a Simucube base is not found.

settings.label: Smoothing filter type
settings.help: Filter behind the in-sim smoothing slider. Slew rate softens jolts; boxcar is the old filter.

options.label: Slew rate limiter
options.tip: Caps how fast force can change. Softens kerb and wall hits. Default.

settings.label: Bump stop range
settings.help: Degrees past the car's steering lock before the stop hits full force. Raise on strong wheels.
settings.danger: Low values on strong wheels can bounce the rim hard off the lock.

settings.label: Damper stability
settings.help: Gain of iRacing's damper loop. Lower it if damping gets noisy or unstable. Default: 0.05.
settings.danger: Too high makes the damper unstable and the wheel can oscillate.

settings.label: Friction damper amount
settings.help: Friction damping, 0 to 1. The in-sim damping slider overrides it. 0.05 to 0.2 works best.

settings.label: Parked force reduction
settings.help: Share of FFB removed when parked (0.33 = 33%). Stops the wheel oscillating at rest.

settings.label: Max cars
settings.help: Most cars the server sends you. Higher costs CPU and FPS; timing apps want 63.
settings.caution: High values can cut FPS noticeably on weaker CPUs.

settings.label: UI loading screen
settings.help: Shows the iRacing UI's loading screen while the sim loads. Off uses the sim's own.

settings.label: UI safe mode
settings.help: Basic graphics for the iRacing UI app. Support advises 0 if the UI crashes at start.

options.label: On
options.tip: Basic graphics. Fixes a blank window; no 3D car viewer.

settings.label: Date format
settings.help: Order of day, month and year in dates. Value meanings not documented.

settings.label: Real-time clock
settings.help: Shows the real-world time of day in the sim.

settings.label: Units
settings.help: Imperial or metric for speeds, pressures and lengths.

settings.label: Clock time zone
settings.help: Purpose not documented. iRacing's note says real time in a set time zone.

settings.label: Open black box
settings.help: Which black box is open on the session screen. -1 is none.

settings.label: Collapse black box
settings.help: Shows session-screen black boxes in their compact state.

settings.label: Weather radar
settings.help: Shows the weather radar on the session screen.

settings.label: Farms without Anycast
settings.help: Farms that skip Anycast routing, comma-separated (e.g. use2,euc1). For farms where Anycast pings worse.

settings.label: Farms without IPv6
settings.help: Farms that use IPv4 instead of IPv6, comma-separated (e.g. use2,apse2). Only matters with IPv6 on.

settings.label: Auto-apply garage changes
settings.help: Applies garage changes after 5 seconds without input. Off means pressing Apply yourself.

settings.label: Server address choice
settings.help: Which address to use when a race server resolves to several. Leave at 0 unless support asks.

settings.label: Record telemetry to disk
settings.help: Saves an .ibt file every session.

settings.label: Allow telemetry files
settings.help: Master switch for .ibt telemetry files. Off stops all disk logging, including in-car logging.

settings.label: Live telemetry
settings.help: SimHub, overlays and dashboards read iRacing through this.

settings.label: Limit telemetry file size
settings.help: Splits files at 100 MB.

settings.label: 360 Hz telemetry
settings.help: Logs shock and steering torque at 360 Hz, not 60 Hz. Breaks some FFB and motion apps.
settings.danger: Breaks some apps, e.g. AccuForce Sim Commander falls back to plain FFB.

settings.label: Log all cars
settings.help: Telemetry covers every car in the session, not just the first 64. For big fields.
settings.danger: Apps that expect 64-car arrays may misread data.

settings.label: Log car setup
settings.help: Writes your car setup into telemetry. Setup and data-analysis tools need it on.

settings.label: UTF-8 session data
settings.help: Sends driver and team names as UTF-8 so non-Latin characters show. Check your apps cope.

options.label: UTF-8
options.tip: Shows all characters. Some older apps misread it.

settings.label: Incident messages
settings.help: Shows incident messages on screen while you drive. Off hides them while in the car.

settings.label: Join and leave messages
settings.help: Shows a message when a driver joins or leaves the session.

settings.label: System messages
settings.help: Shows sim system messages on screen while you drive.

settings.label: Chat while driving
settings.help: Shows text chat from other drivers while you drive. Off cuts distraction.

settings.label: What's New seen
settings.help: Records which What's New popup you last saw. The sim updates it.

settings.label: Search headings
settings.help: Options search also matches section headings.

settings.label: Search near matches
settings.help: Options search also matches related tags, not only names.

settings.label: Search tooltips
settings.help: Options search also matches tooltip text.

settings.label: Ticker without UI
settings.help: Shows the ticker when the session UI is hidden. For broadcast screens.

settings.label: Autofuel on by default
settings.help: Autofuel starts enabled and switches back on each time you leave the pits.

settings.label: Autofuel margin
settings.help: Extra laps of fuel Autofuel adds as a safety margin.

settings.label: Re-request fast repair
settings.help: Ticks fast repair again each time you leave the pits.

settings.label: Reset pit requests
settings.help: Re-ticks full service (fuel, tyres) each time you leave the pits. Off keeps your choices.

settings.label: Save prompt on quit
settings.help: Asks to save the replay when you press Quit.

settings.label: Playback CPU limit
settings.help: Slows fast playback when the sim's realtime thread hits this CPU %. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: CPU check interval
settings.help: Seconds between checks of playback CPU load.

settings.label: Voice chat review
settings.help: Plays recorded voice chat in the replay by default. Saved replays turn it on anyway.

settings.label: Keep playback between sessions
settings.help: Leaves replay playback as is when the session changes, e.g. qualifying to race.

settings.label: Search frames per update
settings.help: Replay frames scanned per update when seeking. Internal tuning.

settings.label: Free the number pad
settings.help: Removes the default replay controls from the number pad.

settings.label: Pause replay on exit
settings.help: Pauses the replay when you leave the car.

settings.label: Rewind on exit
settings.help: Seconds the replay backs up when you leave the car, 0 to 60.

settings.label: Rewind on exit, team
settings.help: Seconds the replay backs up when you leave the car in team events, 0 to 60.

settings.label: Search delay
settings.help: Minimum ms between long replay searches. Internal tuning.

settings.label: Correct other cars
settings.help: Corrects other cars' positions in the replay from server data.
settings.danger: Off can leave other cars out of place in replays.

settings.label: Spool replay to disk
settings.help: Writes the replay to disk while you drive, so long races save in full.

settings.label: Minimum free disk
settings.help: Spooling stays off unless this many MB are free. 0 skips the check.

settings.label: Side calls from green
settings.help: Gives car low/high calls from the green flag. Off holds them briefly after the start.

settings.label: Clear margin
settings.help: Metres of gap, front and back, before a car alongside is called clear. Higher calls clear later.

settings.label: Spotter on
settings.help: Master switch for the spotter and crew chief.

settings.label: Quiet time after hush
settings.help: Seconds the spotter stays silent when hushed.

settings.label: Mute for live spotter
settings.help: Silences the AI spotter while a human spotter is spotting for you.

settings.label: Quieter with live spotter
settings.help: Makes the AI spotter less chatty while a human spotter is spotting for you.

settings.label: Damage reports
settings.help: Reports new damage to your car. More detail at higher chattiness.

settings.label: Rival pit reports
settings.help: Reports when the car ahead or behind for position pits.

settings.label: Faster class warnings
settings.help: Warns when a faster class car is about to pass. Needs Medium chattiness or higher.

settings.label: Fuel data reminders
settings.help: Reminds you to run clean laps for fuel data, then says when it's collected.

settings.label: Gap reports
settings.help: Reports cars closing in or dropping back.

settings.label: Grid SOF report
settings.help: Reads the strength of field while you grid for a race.

settings.label: Grid weather report
settings.help: Reports rain, or rain clearing, while you grid for a race.

settings.label: Incident reports
settings.help: Reports incidents and off-tracks.

settings.label: Weather change reports
settings.help: Reports rain arriving or stopping, or getting heavier or lighter.

settings.label: Lap time callouts
settings.help: Reads your lap time every lap.

settings.label: Leader lap time
settings.help: Reads the class leader's lap time now and then.

settings.label: Say the minute
settings.help: Includes the minute when reading lap times. Off reads the seconds only.

settings.label: Lap callout type
settings.help: Reads each lap as a time or as average speed.

options.label: Average speed
options.tip: Reads average speed for the lap.

settings.label: Class fastest lap
settings.help: Reports when a new fastest lap is set in your class.

settings.label: Fastest lap time
settings.help: Adds the lap time to fastest-lap reports.

settings.label: Personal best reports
settings.help: Reports your new personal best in practice, testing, time attack and warmup.

settings.label: Personal best in races
settings.help: Reports your new personal best during races. Off limits it to other sessions.

settings.label: Lap time decimals
settings.help: Decimal places read out in lap times. 3 is thousandths. Lower is shorter.

settings.label: End-of-race encouragement
settings.help: Messages in the last laps.

settings.label: Lead changes
settings.help: Reports when the race has a new leader.

settings.label: Pit box countdown
settings.help: Counts you down to your pit box on pit road, at any chattiness.

settings.label: Spotter text
settings.help: Shows spotter messages as on-screen text.

settings.label: Text display time
settings.help: Multiplies how long spotter text stays on screen. 2 is twice as long.

settings.label: Message topic filter
settings.help: Purpose not documented. Likely filters spotter message topics. Leave at 0.
settings.danger: Effect unknown. Non-zero values may hide spotter calls.

settings.label: Chattiness
settings.help: How much the spotter talks. Several calls need Medium or High.

options.label: Medium
options.tip: Adds faster-class warnings and more race reports.

settings.label: Spotter voice
settings.help: Spoken spotter calls. Turn off to keep text only.

settings.label: Voice pack
settings.help: Spotter voice pack folder in iRacing\sound\spcc. Blank is the default. Restart to apply.

settings.label: Default spectator focus
settings.help: What the camera follows when you join as a spectator.

settings.label: Spotting as spectator
settings.help: Shows Start/Stop spotting when you join as a spectator. For spotting a team you're not on.

settings.label: Comparison lap file
settings.help: Lap file (.blap or .olap) for the comparison delta mode. Loaded in the sim's Options.

settings.label: Delta bar
settings.help: Shows the delta bar alongside split times or the ghost car.

settings.label: Reference lap
settings.help: Which lap splits and delta compare against. 0 turns it off. Tab cycles it in the car.

settings.label: Time Attack reference lap
settings.help: Reference lap used in Time Attack sessions. 0 turns it off.

settings.label: Ghost car
settings.help: Shows a ghost car driving the reference lap. Not allowed in every session.

settings.label: Delta range, ovals
settings.help: Seconds either side the delta bar covers at ovals.

settings.label: Delta range, road
settings.help: Seconds either side the delta bar covers on road courses.

settings.label: Hide splits at start
settings.help: Turns split times off when a race starts. Tab turns them back on.

settings.label: Fade ghost when close
settings.help: Makes the ghost car more see-through as you get near it.

settings.label: Ghost car offset
settings.help: Shifts the ghost car in time, in seconds.

settings.label: Ghost car transparency
settings.help: How see-through the ghost car is, 0 to 1.

settings.label: Ghost car readout
settings.help: Readout drawn above the ghost car on track. What each style shows is not documented.

settings.label: Audio meters
settings.help: Audio CPU meters (A and X) in the FPS box.

settings.label: Graphics meters
settings.help: Render CPU, GPU and total frame-time meters (R, G, T). Shows CPU or GPU limits.

settings.label: Network meters
settings.help: Latency and packet-loss meters (L, Q) in the FPS box.

settings.label: Force feedback meter
settings.help: Force feedback meter (F). Shows when the wheel is clipping.

settings.label: System meters
settings.help: Physics CPU, time skew and page-fault meters (C, S, P).

settings.label: FPS and meters
settings.help: Shows the FPS box and the meters set above. F key toggles it in the car.

settings.label: Invert tilt steering
settings.help: Reverses the tilt steering direction. 1 inverts.

settings.label: Invert tilt pedals
settings.help: Reverses the tilt gas/brake axis. 1 inverts.

settings.label: Tilt steering range
settings.help: Tilt angle, in degrees, for full steering. Lower is more sensitive.

settings.label: Tilt pedal range
settings.help: Tilt angle, in degrees, for full gas or brake. Lower is more sensitive.

settings.label: Detect tilt sensors
settings.help: Looks for tilt sensors, as in tablets. Leave off unless you steer by tilting.

settings.label: Use orientation sensor
settings.help: On uses the device's orientation sensor for tilt; off uses the accelerometer.

settings.label: Mouse driving controls
settings.help: Enables mouse driving controls in the car. Used with touch/mouse steering.

settings.label: Centre steering on touch
settings.help: Your first touch sets the steering centre, instead of a fixed spot.

settings.label: Centre pedals on touch
settings.help: Your first touch sets the gas/brake neutral point, instead of a fixed spot.

settings.label: Combo zone height
settings.help: Height of the centre steer-and-pedal zone, as a share of screen width (1 = 100%).

settings.label: Single combo cursor
settings.help: Uses one cursor for both steering and pedals on the centre combo control.

settings.label: Combo zone width
settings.help: Width of the centre steer-and-pedal zone, as a share of screen width (1 = 100%).

settings.label: Return speed
settings.help: How fast touch controls return to neutral once released.

settings.label: Click to lock mouse
settings.help: Click once to take mouse driving control, click again to release it.

settings.label: Side zone edge offset
settings.help: How far the left and right touch zones sit from the screen edges (horizontal layout).

settings.label: Vertical gas/brake zone
settings.help: On: the right-hand gas/brake zone runs up and down. Off: side to side.

settings.label: Side zone height
settings.help: Height of the left and right touch zones, as a share of screen width (vertical layout).

settings.label: Hide side zones
settings.help: Hides the side touch zones when touch is not in use.

settings.label: Vertical steering zone
settings.help: On: the left-hand steering zone runs up and down. Off: side to side.

settings.label: Side zone width
settings.help: Width of the left and right touch zones, as a share of screen width (horizontal layout).

settings.label: Relative mouse mode
settings.help: On: mouse movement nudges the input. Off: pointer position sets it directly.

settings.label: Rim vibration
settings.help: Adds audio-style vibration to TrueForce-type wheels. Also in the sim's options.

settings.label: Logitech TrueForce API
settings.help: Links to Logitech TrueForce wheels (G923, G PRO). Set 0 to troubleshoot.

settings.label: TrueForce damping
settings.help: Adds light internal damping to TrueForce wheels to give them weight. Default: 0.05.

settings.label: Force TrueForce gain
settings.help: Sets the wheel's TrueForce gain to 100% at launch. Set 0 to keep your wheel-menu tuning.

settings.label: Vibration source
settings.help: Physics effects or the car's engine audio as the rim vibration source.

options.label: Game audio
options.tip: Vibration follows the car's engine sound.

options.label: Physics
options.tip: Separate effects: kerbs, slip, shifts and more. Default.

settings.label: Master level
settings.help: Overall rim vibration level, in dB. Negative is weaker; about 6 dB halves or doubles it.

settings.label: Body movement
settings.help: Chassis load changes, impacts and heavy kerb hits, in dB. 0 is iRacing's base level.

settings.label: Engine revs
settings.help: Engine vibration that follows revs, in dB. Often cut, as the dash and sound already show it.

settings.label: Gear change
settings.help: Thump on each upshift and downshift, in dB.

settings.label: Rev limiter
settings.help: Pulse when the engine hits the limiter, in dB.

settings.label: Road texture
settings.help: Constant surface grain, in dB. Kept low so it doesn't mask other effects.

settings.label: Kerbs
settings.help: Rumble strip and kerb vibration, in dB.

settings.label: Wheel slip
settings.help: Vibration when a tyre passes its grip limit, in dB. Also carries ABS.

settings.label: Screenshot format
settings.help: File type for iRacing's screenshots.

settings.label: Built-in capture
settings.help: Loads iRacing's video and screenshot capture. Needed for the capture hotkeys.

settings.label: Record microphone
settings.help: Adds your microphone to captured video.

settings.label: Video format
settings.help: Container for iRacing's video recordings.

settings.label: Video frame rate
settings.help: Frame rate for captured video.

settings.label: Video size
settings.help: Maximum resolution for captured video.

settings.label: Look left/right angle
settings.help: Degrees your head turns for look left and look right.

settings.label: Look dead zone
settings.help: Dead zone for an analogue look axis, 0 to 1. 0 is none.

settings.label: Look down angle
settings.help: Degrees your head tilts for look down.

settings.label: Instant look
settings.help: Look buttons snap straight to the angle. Off pans smoothly.

settings.label: Look smoothing
settings.help: Smoothing time for an analogue look axis, in seconds.

settings.label: Look up angle
settings.help: Degrees your head tilts for look up.

settings.label: Level head in roll
settings.help: Higher keeps your head level with the horizon as the car rolls. 0 moves with the chassis.

settings.label: Level head in pitch
settings.help: Higher keeps your head level as the car pitches over crests. 0 moves with the chassis.

settings.label: Neck motion
settings.help: How much your head sways on bumps. Lower it for VR or a motion rig.

settings.label: Driver height
settings.help: Raises or lowers your eye point, up to 0.05 m either way.

settings.label: Rotate with velocity
settings.help: Turns your view toward the direction of travel in a slide. Helps you sense oversteer.

settings.label: Field of view
settings.help: Driving view FOV in degrees. Use the sim's FOV calculator; [ and ] adjust it live.

settings.label: Horizon offset
settings.help: Shifts the horizon up or down without moving the camera.

settings.label: Virtual mirror FOV
settings.help: Field of view of the virtual mirror in degrees. Wider shows more, but smaller.

settings.label: Auto performance meters
settings.help: Pops up the performance meters when the physics thread looks overloaded. Off stops the pop-up.

settings.label: Debug text background
settings.help: Background colour of debug text, as r,g,b[,a]. Developer use.

settings.label: Debug text colour
settings.help: Colour of debug text, as r,g,b[,a]. Developer use.

settings.label: Crash on maths error
settings.help: Kills the app with a crash log on a floating-point error. Developer debugging.
settings.danger: Turns minor maths errors into crashes.

settings.label: Crash on error, physics
settings.help: Kills the sim with a crash log on a floating-point error in the physics thread.
settings.danger: Turns minor maths errors into crashes.

settings.label: Crash on error, graphics
settings.help: Kills the sim with a crash log on a floating-point error in the graphics thread.
settings.danger: Turns minor maths errors into crashes.

settings.label: Mask maths errors, physics
settings.help: Ignores floating-point errors in the physics thread. Developer use.

settings.label: Mask maths errors, graphics
settings.help: Ignores floating-point errors in the graphics thread. Developer use.

settings.label: Hang limit, physics
settings.help: Seconds the physics thread can stall before the hang watchdog trips. 0 is off.
settings.danger: A low value can close the sim during long loads.

settings.label: Hang limit, graphics
settings.help: Seconds the render thread can stall before the hang watchdog trips. 0 is off.
settings.danger: A low value can close the sim during long loads.

settings.label: Tyre tests on startup
settings.help: Runs the full set of tyre test sweeps when the sim starts. Developer use.

settings.label: Mosaic image height
settings.help: Height in pixels of a mosaic capture. Purpose not documented; likely hi-res screenshots.

settings.label: Mosaic tiles across
settings.help: Number of tiles across in a mosaic capture. Purpose not documented.

settings.label: Mosaic image width
settings.help: Width in pixels of a mosaic capture. Must be a multiple of 4 × tiles across.
settings.danger: Must be a multiple of 4 × tiles across.

settings.label: Alternate IP lookup
settings.help: Finds local IP addresses by another method. Leave as is unless support asks.

settings.label: Separate handshake socket
settings.help: Uses a separate local port for the first handshake with the server. Leave as is.

settings.label: Connected sockets
settings.help: Support fix for errors 10035, 10054 and 10057: set to 1. Put back to 0 if it doesn't help.

settings.label: Connection timeout
settings.help: Seconds to keep trying to open a network connection.

settings.label: Initial packet size
settings.help: Starting maximum payload per network packet, in bytes.
settings.danger: Too large can cause dropped packets and disconnects.

settings.label: Congestion signalling
settings.help: Uses Explicit Congestion Notification so routers can flag congestion without dropping packets.

settings.label: Packet size probing
settings.help: Probes for the largest packet size your connection supports. Off by default.

settings.label: Log channel statistics
settings.help: Writes network channel statistics to the log. For diagnosis.

settings.label: Log comms errors
settings.help: Logs errors on client network channels. For diagnosis.

settings.label: Log connections
settings.help: Logs a message as clients connect. Mainly for servers.

settings.label: Max probe size
settings.help: Largest packet size, in bytes, tried when packet size probing is on.

settings.label: Dummy remote
settings.help: Turns on a test remote in debug builds. No effect in the normal sim.

settings.label: Ignore reference-line mismatches
settings.help: Ignores mismatched track reference-line cache files. Developer use.
settings.danger: Can mask a corrupt track cache.

settings.label: Updater HTTP logging
settings.help: Logs the updater's web traffic. For download troubleshooting.

settings.label: Data file cache
settings.help: Memory for caching sim data files, in bytes (4194304 is 4 MB). Undocumented; leave as is.

settings.label: Test session pit stall
settings.help: Stall number for test sessions. 0 or 1 is the first stall.

settings.label: Telemetry in replays
settings.help: Purpose not documented. Likely stores extra car telemetry in the replay file.

settings.label: Full-rate telemetry
settings.help: Purpose not documented. Likely records that telemetry at physics rate. Larger files.

settings.label: Telemetry channels
settings.help: Sum of: 1 header, 2 chassis, 4 wheel, 8 tyre, 16 driveline, 32 inputs.

settings.label: Telemetry states
settings.help: When to record. Sum of: 1 on track, 2 in car, 4 paused, 8 setup, 16 pit stop.

settings.label: Unused
settings.help: Unused, per iRacing's own comment.

settings.label: Replay memory
settings.help: RAM for replays, in KB. 0 is automatic. Raise if long races don't save in full.
settings.caution: More than your free RAM can cause stutter or crashes.

settings.label: Hide admins
settings.help: Hides which drivers are session admins. Server-side; likely no effect on your client.

settings.label: Admin-only connections
settings.help: Connections a server keeps for admins. Server-side; likely no effect on your client.

settings.label: Mono positional sounds
settings.help: Folds stereo samples to mono for positioned 3D sounds. Purpose not fully documented.

settings.label: Forced buffer size
settings.help: Forces the sound buffer size in 1/60 s units, 3 or more. 0 leaves it automatic.
settings.danger: Wrong values can add crackle or audio lag.

settings.label: Minimum read-ahead
settings.help: Forces sound read-ahead in 1/60 s ticks. Purpose not documented further.
settings.danger: Wrong values can cause crackle or dropouts.

settings.label: No worker thread boost
settings.help: Stops Windows boosting the priority of low-priority worker threads. Leave as is.

settings.label: Lower priority when loading
settings.help: Purpose not documented. Likely lowers the sim's CPU priority while loading.

settings.label: Telemetry ID
settings.help: Purpose not documented. An identifier where @ stands for the server port.

settings.label: Session info interval
settings.help: Seconds between session info updates in telemetry. Undocumented; leave at 10.

settings.label: Updater log
settings.help: Writes an updater log to Documents\iRacing\logs. Useful for update problems.
